### 原始状态进入

在多 Session Coding 中，输入侧 Session 按[职责归属](session-role-ownership_zh_cn.md)要求读取派发前确认所需的有界、只读环境与代码证据，不进行开放式项目扫描。Primary Output 仅在父级确认和放行的范围内读取更多源代码/配置状态；Change Verification 消费最终状态证据；Documentation/Comments & Git Operations 消费 Git 状态和获准文档范围。各自只返回下一步决策需要的事实与准确来源。

原始状态摄入边界由潜在输出体积、状态敏感性和仓库影响决定，而不是命令名称。单 Session 没有跨 Session Firewall，但仍须渐进读取并压缩原始状态。

### 语义 ownership 和临时定位

Firewall 只限制原始状态进入，不转移语义责任；语义权威性遵循[职责归属](session-role-ownership_zh_cn.md)。临时项目定位事实不自动提升为长期 Contract 状态，也不应倾倒原始状态。经授权且可复用的上下文记录可按 [Coding Context Exchange](../context-exchange/context-exchange_zh_cn.md) 和 [Coding Context Exchange Workspace Boundary](../context-exchange/context-exchange-workspace-boundary_zh_cn.md) 使用具名项目 Memory 持久化；Memory 名称只表达逻辑归属，不提供技术隔离。

source_units.excerpt:
Codex custom agent profiles may narrow source/tool exposure with `sandbox_mode: read-only` and selected `mcp_servers`; `developer_instructions` can request bounded source pointers but is not a permission boundary. Inspect inherited settings because omitted custom-agent fields inherit the parent. These settings are not Claude's `tools`/`disallowedTools` frontmatter and do not imply Claude Desktop Chat's connector Tool-access mode. [OpenAI: custom subagents](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/agent-configuration/subagents).

### Local bounded tools and Skill/MCP disclosure

Do not reread unchanged owners or retrieve history already present in the active context. Prefer stable context plus a small delta. When tool output repeats the same payload in `content` and `structuredContent`, retain only the representation needed for the next decision; preserve distinct evidence and source pointers.

Use the runtime's exposed local code-search/file-reading tools for targeted symbols and small source ranges, returning stable paths and evidence pointers instead of complete build logs or recursive repository dumps. For Codex role-specific access, a reviewed custom agent may set `sandbox_mode: read-only` and narrow `mcp_servers`; an omitted key can inherit parent settings and a live permission override can affect the spawned child. Local Codex skills reveal metadata first, load `SKILL.md` when selected and references only on demand; select only concept owners needed by the current slice. The CLI/IDE/Desktop Codex host can share MCP configuration; `/mcp` verifies available connections. Do not treat a plugin or a separate Chat Session's tool access as a separate Codex child or a permission grant. [OpenAI: skills progressive disclosure](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/build-skills), [OpenAI: MCP host configuration](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/extend/mcp), [OpenAI: custom agents](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/agent-configuration/subagents).

Codex 的自定义 Agent profile 可以用只读 `sandbox_mode` 和指定 `mcp_servers` 收窄源码及工具访问范围；`developer_instructions` 可以要求有界来源指针，但不是权限边界。必须检查继承设置，因为自定义 Agent 中省略的字段可继承父级。这些设置不等同于 Claude 的 `tools`／`disallowedTools` frontmatter，也不代表 Claude Desktop Chat 的 connector Tool-access 模式。[OpenAI：自定义子代理](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/agent-configuration/subagents)。

### 有界本地工具与 Skill／MCP 按需披露

不要重复读取未变更的 owner，也不要重新取回当前上下文中已经存在的历史。优先保留稳定上下文并追加小幅 delta。工具输出同时在 `content` 和 `structuredContent` 中重复同一载荷时，只保留下一步决策所需的一种表示；不同证据和来源指针仍须保留。

使用运行环境实际暴露的本地代码检索／文件读取工具定位符号和少量源代码区间，返回稳定路径与证据指针，而非完整构建日志或仓库递归列表。Codex 自定义 Agent 可以通过经审查的 `sandbox_mode: read-only` 和窄范围 `mcp_servers` 限定职责访问；省略的字段可能继承父级设置，父级实时权限覆盖还可能影响创建后的 Child。本地 Codex Skill 先暴露元数据，选中后才加载 `SKILL.md`，references 则按需读取；只选择当前 Slice 所需的概念 owner。CLI／IDE／Desktop Codex 宿主可共享 MCP 配置，通过 `/mcp` 核实连接；不能把插件或独立 Chat Session 的工具访问当成额外 Codex Child 或权限授权。[OpenAI：Skills 渐进式披露](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/build-skills)、[OpenAI：MCP 宿主配置](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/extend/mcp)、[OpenAI：自定义 Agent](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/agent-configuration/subagents)。

source_units.excerpt:
### Session semantics

The active workflow supplies mode, topology, role allocation, lifecycle, reuse, replacement, exceptions, and unavailable handling. A role label never authorizes a new Session or topology change.

Here, a Session means the host-identified Session lifetime, not one user/assistant exchange. Later turns and a compacted or resumed instance of the same Session retain its mode, count, and child identities. A Fork with a new Session identity starts a separate lifetime and must pass fresh re-entry gates.

A Fork starts a new Coding Session with a new root identity. Re-enter fresh mode/count selection before dependent work, even when the source Session used Single-Agent mode. Child identities bound to the source Session are foreign in the Fork: do not adopt them as created children, reuse or resume them, count them toward its capacity, or offer them as current-session candidates. The [Delegation Mode Re-entry](../delegation/delegation-mode-reentry.md) and [Session State Record](../delegation/delegation-state-record.md) owners govern the new record.

In Single-Agent Coding, the current Session performs the logical decision, implementation, documentation, Git, and allowed-check phases; logical roles do not imply independent Agents. In Multi-Agent Coding, use only the child execution contexts explicitly supplied by the active workflow; their exact Session isolation depends on the runtime provider:

```text
root parent context → Input-side Reasoning
assigned Primary child context → Primary Output
assigned verifier child context → Change Verification
assigned docs/Git child context → Documentation/Comments & Git Operations
```

An unassigned role is unavailable as an independent child context. Do not infer a role from the number of reserved slots; one slot does not automatically mean Primary Output. Select a role only after current task context and Decision are reviewed, then record it in an unassigned slot under the role-selection and allocation owners. Do not simulate independence by relabeling same-context work.

### Primary Execution Session and affinity

Maintain one Primary Execution Session: the current Session in Single-Agent mode; in Multi-Agent mode, the created child assigned `Primary Output`, when one exists. Until that child exists, the current root Session remains the active decision context, not an implied Primary child. Reuse the assigned Primary Session for related exploration, implementation, diagnosis, tests, repairs, and local execution to preserve stable context. A Session is sticky but not immortal; lifecycle changes use the active workflow's recorded state.

Session isolation and Git worktree isolation are distinct. Workspace and filesystem isolation requirements belong to [Coding Context Exchange Workspace Boundary](../context-exchange/context-exchange-workspace-boundary.md); Session reuse alone does not prove cache hits or runtime savings.

source_units.excerpt:
### Session 语义

模式、拓扑、职责分配、生命周期、复用、替换、例外和不可用处理由当前工作流提供。职责名称本身不能授权新建 Session 或改变拓扑。

本文中的 Session 指宿主识别的完整 Session 生命周期，而不是一次用户/助手交互。同一 Session 的后续轮次、compact 或恢复都沿用其模式、数量和子代理身份。具有新 Session 身份的 Fork 开始独立生命周期，必须重新通过门禁。

Fork 会以新的根身份开启新的 Coding Session。在开展依赖工作前，必须重新通过模式/数量选择，即使来源 Session 使用过 Single-Agent 模式也一样。绑定到来源 Session 的子代理身份在 Fork 中属于其他会话：不得将其采纳为已创建子代理、复用或恢复、计入新会话预算，或提供给当前会话候选选择。新状态记录由[委派模式重入](../delegation/delegation-mode-reentry_zh_cn.md)和[委派状态记录](../delegation/delegation-state-record_zh_cn.md) owner 负责。

单代理 Coding 中，当前 Session 执行逻辑上的决策、实现、文档、Git 和允许的检查阶段；逻辑职责不表示存在独立 Agent。多代理 Coding 中，只使用当前工作流明确提供的子级执行上下文；具体 Session 隔离由运行环境决定：

```text
根父上下文 → Input-side Reasoning
已分配 Primary 子级上下文 → Primary Output
已分配 verifier 子级上下文 → Change Verification
已分配文档/Git 子级上下文 → Documentation/Comments & Git Operations
```

未分配的职责在独立子级上下文层面不可用。不得通过给同一上下文的工作改名来模拟独立性。
不得从预留名额数量推断职责；一个名额不会自动表示 Primary Output。只有审阅当前任务上下文和 Decision 后才能选择职责，再由职责选择与分配 owner 记录到未分配名额中。

### Primary Execution Session 与 Affinity

维持一个 Primary Execution Session：Single-Agent 模式下为当前 Session；Multi-Agent 模式下为已经创建且分配了 `Primary Output` 的子代理（如果存在）。在该子代理创建前，当前根 Session 仍是活跃决策上下文，但这不隐含创建 Primary 子代理。相关探索、实现、诊断、测试、修复和局部执行优先复用已分配的 Primary Session，以保留稳定上下文。Session 应保持 sticky but not immortal；生命周期变化遵循当前工作流的已记录状态。

Session 隔离与 Git worktree 隔离不同。工作区和文件系统隔离条件由[上下文工作区边界](../context-exchange/context-exchange-workspace-boundary_zh_cn.md)定义；不得仅因复用 Session 就声称命中缓存或获得其他运行时收益。

source_units.excerpt:
An allocated Codex child uses an independent child Session. Confirm that relationship only through runtime metadata or a directly exposed child/thread tool, and report only the isolation those sources establish.

For Codex, the Session runs from the host Session's start until it ends; it is not reset by each user/assistant turn. Compaction and reopening or resuming the same Session retain its mode/count and child-identity record. A Fork creates a new Session identity and follows the fresh re-entry gate.

### Desktop Session and child identities

In ChatGPT Desktop, count a spawned Codex thread as a child only when a tool exposed to the active Session reports that parent-child relationship. A tool that creates or transfers another Session or worktree does not by itself establish a child identity; Codex-managed worktrees can be detached-HEAD and disposable. A Chat or Work Session is not a Codex child unless an exposed tool reports that relation. [OpenAI: subagent threads](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/agent-configuration/subagents), [OpenAI: worktree behavior](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/environments/git-worktrees), [OpenAI: Desktop modes](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/use-chatgpt).

已分配的 Codex 子代理使用独立子 Session。只有运行时元数据或直接暴露的子代理／线程工具能够证明该关系；只报告这些来源明确显示的隔离能力。

对 Codex 而言，Session 从宿主 Session 开始持续到其结束，不会因每轮用户/助手交互而重置。对同一 Session 执行 compact、重新打开或恢复时，沿用其模式/数量及子代理身份记录。Fork 会创建新的 Session 身份，必须重新通过模式重入门禁。

### Desktop Session 与子代理身份

在 ChatGPT Desktop 中，只有当前 Session 暴露的工具报告明确父子关系时，才将 spawned Codex thread 记为 Child。通过工具创建或转移另一个 Session／worktree 本身不能建立子代理身份；Codex 管理的 worktree 可能是 detached HEAD 且可清理。只有暴露的工具报告相关关系时，Chat 或 Work Session 才能算作 Codex Child。[OpenAI：子代理线程](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/agent-configuration/subagents)、[OpenAI：worktree 行为](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/environments/git-worktrees)、[OpenAI：Desktop 模式](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/use-chatgpt)。

source_units.excerpt:
### Input-side Reasoning Agent

Owns instruction analysis, project-environment confirmation, and direct confirmation of the code details needed to define a task, as well as the Semantic Contract, architecture and risk decisions, unresolved trade-offs, stage and slice boundaries, release decisions, checkpoint outcomes, user interaction, and final semantic acceptance. Before assigning a child, it must complete these confirmations itself and turn them into precise instructions with source pointers and acceptance conditions. It must not delegate these prerequisite judgments to a child. It inspects only the bounded evidence needed for those confirmations and does not absorb unrelated high-volume raw project state or expand already-approved decisions into long output.

### Primary Output Role

Owns execution of the parent's precise, released task instructions, including bounded exploration within the confirmed scope, evidence compression, code/configuration materialization, repairs within the released slice, and provisional implementation checks. Within the existing Contract, it proactively designs and runs applicable negative, boundary, and concurrency checks; it reports gaps and evidence. A check or fix outside released scope, or one requiring a new architecture decision, returns to the parent before action. Under the Multi-Agent route, create this child only after the normal release gates and only for actual code/configuration implementation or authorship/editing of this Skill's instructions/reference documents. It reads progressively and reports any fact that contradicts the parent's confirmed premises; it cannot take over the prerequisite instruction analysis, environment confirmation, or code-detail confirmation, or change unresolved goals, constraints, architecture, or acceptance criteria. It does not own final acceptance or non-trivial Git work. Apply the configured Worker summary cadence and complete message visibility without duplicating a complete final return.

### Context Bootstrap/Refresh Responsibility

When assigned, builds or refreshes a bounded, fingerprinted capsule of neutral project facts, exact source pointers, policy-routing pointers, and freshness data. It does not decide the task, change the Contract, implement, verify, materialize documentation, or delegate recursively. The capsule supplements mandatory instructions and never replaces direct reading of authoritative files.

### Change Verification Agent

When assigned, independently verifies the final state of a material change against the Contract and acceptance criteria. It uses the supplied scope evidence, runs relevant holistic and targeted checks, re-evaluates every final-state fingerprint/epoch, and reports evidence, gaps, failures, and risks. It is read-only for product code/configuration, documentation, and Git, except for explicitly named verification assets; it does not repair, make semantic decisions, or delegate.

### Documentation/Comments & Git Operations Agent

When assigned, performs only the explicitly released non-trivial Git slice. It does not change product behavior, tests, or semantic decisions; a conflict requiring new content or meaning returns to the parent. The root parent authors ordinary non-Skill documentation/comments, including documentation accompanying code changes; this work never triggers or consumes the reserved Primary Output slot. Authorship/editing of this Skill's instructions or reference documents may be assigned to the Primary Output child after all release gates, with parent review at Documentation and Acceptance. Git remains a separate execution scope.

### 输入侧推理 Agent

负责指令分析、项目环境确认和定义任务所需代码细节的直接事实确认，以及 Semantic Contract、架构和风险决策、未解决的权衡、阶段与 slice 边界、放行决定、checkpoint 结果、用户交互和最终语义验收。分配子代理前，必须亲自完成上述确认，并将其转化为包含源文件定位和验收条件的精确指令；不得将这些前置判断委派给子代理。只检查完成确认所需的有界证据，不摄入无关的高体量项目原始状态，也不把已批准的决定展开成长篇输出。

### Primary 输出角色

负责执行父级已放行的精确任务指令，包括在已确认范围内有界探索、证据压缩、代码/配置物化、已放行 slice 内的修复和临时实现检查。在现有 Contract 内主动设计并运行适用的负面、边界和并发检查，并报告缺口与证据。超出已放行范围的检查/修复，或需要新架构决策的事项，都应先返回父级再行动。Multi-Agent 路线下，只有正常放行门禁完成后，且任务涉及实际代码/配置实现或本 Skill 指令/参考文档编写编辑时，才创建该子代理。它采用渐进式读取，发现与父级已确认前提冲突的事实时须报告；不得接管前置的指令分析、环境确认或代码细节事实确认，也不能改变未解决的目标、约束、架构或验收标准。它不负责最终验收或非简单 Git 工作。遵循配置的 Worker 摘要频率和完整消息可见性，完整最终返回不重复打印。

### Context Bootstrap/Refresh 职责

被分配时，构建或刷新包含中性项目事实、准确 source pointer、policy-routing pointer 和 freshness 数据的有界 fingerprint capsule。它不定义任务、不修改 Contract、不实现、不验证、不物化文档，也不得递归委派。Capsule 只能补充强制指令，不能替代直接读取权威文件。

### Change Verification Agent

被分配时，独立依据 Contract 和验收标准验证实质性改动的最终状态。它消费范围证据，执行适当的整体和定向检查，针对每个最终状态 fingerprint/epoch 重新评估，并报告证据、缺口、失败和风险。除明确点名的验证资产外，它对产品代码/配置、文档和 Git 保持只读；不修复、不作语义决策、不委派。

### Documentation/Comments & Git Operations Agent

被分配时，只执行明确放行的非简单 Git slice。它不得修改产品行为、测试或语义决策；如果冲突需要新的内容或含义，必须返回父级。普通非 Skill 文档/注释（包括伴随代码修改的文档）由根父级编写，绝不触发或消耗预留的 Primary Output 名额。本 Skill 指令/参考文档的编写编辑在所有放行门禁完成后可交由 Primary Output 子代理，并由父级在 Documentation 和 Acceptance 阶段审阅。Git 工作保持为独立执行范围。

Under the default session audit policy, Worker keeps complete safe inbound and outbound messages visible in its own conversation and uses the configured Worker summary cadence. A complete final result already visible is not printed twice.
按默认会话审计策略，Worker 在自身会话中完整展示安全的入站和出站消息，并遵循配置的 Worker 摘要频率。已完整可见的最终结果不重复打印。

source_units.excerpt:
### Assignment boundary

For this owner, a released task means Root has authorized and bounded its objective and scope after Context and Decision. It does not require release of the child-specific Interaction Slice. Executor selection cannot release that later Slice: before implementation or dispatch, Root must still pass the applicable Slice gate and provide the concrete authorized boundary.

Honor an explicit user executor or agent instruction and skip the corresponding advice request. Still check mode, scope, permissions, availability, and current-session identity. An explicit `sub_agent` instruction conflicts with locked Single-Agent mode and must be returned for Root review; do not silently replace it with `root`. An explicit `root` instruction in Single-Agent mode remains valid. Without an explicit executor, Single-Agent mode has no child executor and the local deterministic route may use Root subject to other gates. A Fork is a new Session and must complete fresh mode/count re-entry under [Delegation Mode Re-entry](../delegation/delegation-mode-reentry.md); inherited agents are not current-session candidates under the [Session Model](../session-runtime/session-model.md) and [Delegation State Record](../delegation/delegation-state-record.md).

When the executor is not explicit, Root reviews current task facts and a decision context before considering an advisory executor suggestion. If decision-context generation fails or lacks a fact directly needed by the judgment, do not fabricate a description or hash and do not send the downstream advice request with unusable context. Root may still decide directly from this Skill and verified current facts when they suffice; otherwise keep the decision unresolved for review. A `sub_agent` suggestion with a positive unused approved slot and no existing suitable child may proceed through [Child Role Selection](../delegation/child-role-selection.md) without asking for more budget. Select and reserve its role for the Root-authorized proposed task after Context and Decision and before releasing the child-specific Interaction Slice; the Slice gate must still verify the concrete objective/scope against that role. Executor advice alone does not select a role. When no slot is available but a different role remains unoccupied, Root must use the explicit user-approval route in [Delegation Count Gate](../delegation/delegation-mode-count-gate.md) before reserving that role. If all four roles are occupied, added capacity cannot make another role legal; block creation instead of requesting expansion. An advice failure or insufficient result requires Root review under this owner and never defaults to Root.

### Executor Decisions instructions

Choose `root`, `sub_agent`, or `insufficient_evidence` for the released task. Compare semantic responsibility, task context, required capability, and verified permission facts. Use only the current reviewed task and supplied current-session state. Do not invent a current child, permission, capability, budget, or user instruction. If the task is not released, facts conflict, required capability or permission is unknown, or neither executor can be established as safe, choose `insufficient_evidence`. A `sub_agent` choice with unused approved capacity may continue through role selection and child creation; this tool grants no authority. Never choose `root` only because the Decisions API failed.

### Executor choice descriptions

#### root

Use when Root is the appropriate executor under the released scope, current permissions, context access, and output-token route. Root retains semantic decisions, contract interpretation, orchestration, and final acceptance.

#### sub_agent

Use when a child should perform a concrete released implementation or other eligible slice and the current-session role, capability, permission, and budget gates can be satisfied. If an existing suitable child is available, continue to child selection. If none exists but an approved unused slot remains, continue through role selection and creation. Otherwise request user approval for one different role or return for Root review.

#### insufficient_evidence

Use when the task or current evidence does not establish a safe executor, the required capability or permission is missing or unknown, facts are stale or conflicting, or the request is out of scope. Root must review; do not treat absence of a successful API answer as a Root decision.

### Child-selection Decisions instructions

Choose one eligible child by its opaque `candidate_ref`, or `insufficient_evidence`. Eligibility requires a verified current-session identity, a matching responsibility, required capability, and permission to perform this task. Exclude foreign-session inherited agents and unavailable candidates. A single eligible candidate is used directly without Decisions. With multiple eligible candidates, consider suitable idle candidates before busy candidates; if none are idle, wait until one is. If exactly one idle candidate remains after filtering (because the other eligible candidates are busy), that single idle candidate can be selected directly. This exception does not apply when multiple idle candidates remain. When at least two idle candidates remain, invoke the concrete child-selection Decisions request even if `Primary Output` is preferred. If a suitable idle Primary exists, offer only that candidate and `insufficient_evidence`; otherwise offer all eligible idle candidates and `insufficient_evidence`. If no suitable Primary exists, compare how directly each candidate's supplied context supports the requested task and prefer the candidate with more relevant current context. Do not use raw transcript size, unrelated context volume, or a numeric confidence cutoff. If context relevance is tied or cannot be established, choose `insufficient_evidence` for Root review.

An advice failure may fall back to a suitable current-session `Primary Output` child only when the source policy and current facts remain current. The fallback remains subject to permission and availability: use it only when idle; if busy, wait until idle. A stale policy, stale facts, or identity conflict requires refresh and Root review, never fallback. If no suitable Primary exists, return unresolved review and do not invent a Root fallback. A single eligible candidate is used directly without a Decisions request. Multiple busy candidates require waiting until a suitable child is idle.

### Child-candidate choice descriptions

#### insufficient_evidence

Use when candidates are not distinguishable from the supplied responsibility, capability, permission, availability, and task-relevant context facts, or when the facts do not establish a unique safe selection. Root reviews the current evidence and the explicit task-context preference branch; there is no arbitrary confidence threshold.

### Review and action boundary

Root checks the current fact revision/fingerprint, current-session relationship, candidate identity, permission, capability, release scope, and latest availability before using a result. A tool result is advisory and never dispatches work. Root retains final semantic decisions and acceptance regardless of executor.

### 分配边界

在本文 owner 中，已放行任务是指 Root 在 Context 和 Decision 之后已授权并界定其目标与范围。这不要求面向特定子代理的 Interaction Slice 已放行。执行主体选择本身不能放行后续 Slice：实现或派发前，Root 仍须通过适用的 Slice 门禁并提供具体授权边界。

遵循用户明确的执行主体或 Agent 指令，并跳过相应的建议请求。仍须核验模式、范围、权限、可用性和当前会话身份。显式 `sub_agent` 指令与已锁定的 Single-Agent 模式冲突时，必须交 Root 复核；不得静默改成 `root`。Single-Agent 模式下显式指定 `root` 仍然有效。没有显式执行主体时，Single-Agent 模式没有子代理执行主体，可按本地确定性路径由 Root 处理，但仍须通过其他门禁。Fork 是新 Session，必须按[委派模式重入](../delegation/delegation-mode-reentry_zh_cn.md)重新通过模式/数量门禁；依据[Session 模型](../session-runtime/session-model_zh_cn.md)和[委派状态记录](../delegation/delegation-state-record_zh_cn.md)，继承代理不属于当前会话候选。

执行主体未明确时，Root 审阅当前任务事实和决策上下文，再考虑执行主体建议。若上下文生成失败，或缺少直接影响判断的事实，不得伪造描述/哈希，也不得带着不可用上下文发送下游建议请求。若当前 Skill 和已核实事实足以直接判断，Root 仍可直接决定；否则保留未决状态供审阅。若存在正数未用批准名额且没有合适的现有子代理，`sub_agent` 建议可通过[子代理职责选择](../delegation/child-role-selection_zh_cn.md)继续，无需另行申请预算。Root 须在 Context 与 Decision 之后、该子代理专属 Interaction Slice 放行之前，为已授权的拟派任务选择并预留职责；之后 Slice 门禁仍须核验具体目标/范围与该职责相符。执行主体建议本身不预选职责。没有剩余名额但仍有未占用的不同职责时，Root 必须按[委派数量门禁](../delegation/delegation-mode-count-gate_zh_cn.md)中的用户明确批准流程预留该职责。若四种职责均已占用，扩额不能使另一职责合法可用，必须阻止创建而不得申请扩额。建议能力失败或证据不足时，Root 按本文审阅，绝不默认选择 Root。

### 执行主体 Decisions 指令

为已放行任务选择 `root`、`sub_agent` 或 `insufficient_evidence`。比较语义职责、任务上下文、所需能力和已核实权限。只使用当前审阅任务和已提供的当前会话状态。不得臆造当前子代理、权限、能力、预算或用户指令。任务未放行、事实冲突、必需能力或权限未知，或无法确认任一主体安全执行时，选择 `insufficient_evidence`。若选择 `sub_agent` 且有未用批准名额，可继续职责选择和创建；此工具不授予任何权限。不得仅因 Decisions API 失败就选择 `root`。

### 执行主体选项说明

#### root

当 Root 在已放行范围、当前权限、上下文访问和 Output Token 路由下适合执行时选择。Root 保留语义判断、合同解释、编排和最终验收。

#### sub_agent

当子代理应执行具体的已放行实现或其他合格切片，且当前会话职责、能力、权限和预算门禁均可满足时选择。若有合适现有子代理，继续选择具体子代理。若没有现有子代理但有批准未用名额，继续职责选择和创建。否则请求用户批准一个不同职责，或返回 Root 审阅。

#### insufficient_evidence

当任务或当前证据不足以确定安全执行者、必需能力或权限缺失/未知、事实过期或冲突，或请求超出范围时选择。Root 必须复核；不能把 API 没有成功答复视为 Root 判断。

### 子代理选择 Decisions 指令

从候选中按不透明 `candidate_ref` 选择一个合格子代理，或选择 `insufficient_evidence`。合格要求已核实当前会话身份、职责匹配、所需能力和执行此任务的权限。排除其他会话继承代理和不可用候选。唯一合格候选可直接使用，无需 Decisions。存在多个合格候选时，先考虑适任的空闲子代理，再考虑忙碌者；若都不空闲，等待直到有合适子代理空闲。经过筛选后若只剩一个空闲候选（因为其他合格候选均忙碌），可直接选择该唯一空闲候选。此例外不适用于仍有多个空闲候选的情况。至少有两个空闲候选时，即使 `Primary Output` 具有优先级，也必须调用具体子代理选择 Decisions。若存在合适的空闲 Primary，只向 Decisions 提供该候选和 `insufficient_evidence`；否则提供所有合格空闲候选和 `insufficient_evidence`。若不存在合适 Primary，则比较候选所提供上下文对当前任务的直接支持程度，并优先选择拥有更多相关当前上下文者。不得使用原始 transcript 大小、无关上下文量或数值置信阈值。若上下文相关性相同或无法确认，选择 `insufficient_evidence` 交 Root 审阅。

只有来源政策和当前事实仍然有效时，建议能力失败才可回退到合格的当前会话 `Primary Output` 子代理。回退仍须遵守权限与可用性：仅在其空闲时使用；忙碌时等待其空闲。政策或事实过期、身份冲突时须刷新并交 Root 审阅，绝不回退。若不存在合格 Primary，返回待审阅状态，不得臆造 Root 兜底。唯一合格候选直接使用，无需发送建议请求。多个候选都忙碌时，等待合适子代理空闲。

### 子代理选项说明

#### insufficient_evidence

当提供的职责、能力、权限、可用性和任务相关上下文无法区分候选，或事实不足以安全、唯一地作出选择时使用。Root 审阅当前证据和明确的任务上下文偏好分支；不得设定任意置信阈值。

### 审阅与操作边界

Root 在使用结果前核验当前事实版本/指纹、当前会话关系、候选身份、权限、能力、已放行范围和最新可用性。工具结果仅提供建议，不派发任务。无论执行主体是谁，Root 均保留最终语义判断和验收职责。

source_units.excerpt: For an exposed Codex workflow, call `workflow_select_executor` only when no explicit user executor instruction applies. For `workflow_select_child`, an explicit user candidate skips the advice request after eligibility is checked; one eligible candidate total and exactly one idle candidate after filtering can be selected directly. When two or more eligible idle candidates remain, call the tool even if an idle Primary is preferred. Pass bounded task-relevant context, matching role, capability, permission, and availability facts; offer only the idle Primary plus `insufficient_evidence` when a suitable idle Primary exists, otherwise offer all suitable idle candidates plus `insufficient_evidence`. Compare result hashes to current facts, then verify the selected child through the active parent-controlled identity and permission boundary before dispatch. The tool omits non-offered candidates from the Decisions request, does not read host history, and cannot prove caller-provided identity facts.

对于暴露该能力的 Codex 工作流，仅在用户未明确指定执行主体时调用 `workflow_select_executor`。调用 `workflow_select_child` 时，用户明确指定候选可在核验合格性后跳过建议请求；总计只有一个合格候选，或过滤后恰好剩一个空闲候选时，可直接选择。仍有至少两个合格空闲候选时，即使空闲 Primary 优先，也必须调用该工具。传入有界任务相关上下文、匹配职责、能力、权限和可用性事实；若存在合适空闲 Primary，只提供该 Primary 和 `insufficient_evidence`，否则提供所有合格空闲候选和 `insufficient_evidence`。将结果哈希与当前事实核对，然后在派发前通过有效的父级身份和权限门禁验证选定子代理。工具不会向 Decisions 请求发送未提供的其他候选，不会读取宿主 history，也不能证明调用方提供的身份事实。

source.heading: Codex CLI / ChatGPT Desktop 特别优化指令

source_units.excerpt:
### Default task plan

Every current and future Coding route must consume this owner before implementation and throughout execution. An explicit request for a plan or a dedicated planning mode is unnecessary. Respect an explicit user prohibition on persistence or a higher-priority write restriction: record that exception and keep bounded planning in the authorized context; do not silently treat missing tools, uncertain permissions, or a failed write as an exception. If the user requires a persisted plan and a restriction prevents it, stop the dependent work and report the conflict.

For an Issue task, read the Issue and relevant discussion, compare its requirements with current project facts, and synthesize the proposed change before implementation. Without an Issue, use the user's stated problem and current project facts in the same way. Before the initial analysis is complete, a concise provisional plan may capture the goal, known facts, and unanswered questions; it must not claim an implementation direction is released. Persist and read back the concrete plan before implementation or dependent dispatch. New facts discovered during analysis must be recorded before they are reported or used for the next dependent action.

### Names, storage, and initial evidence

Reuse the user's designated active plan for the same task. Before choosing a new name, confirm whether the authorized backend uses shared global storage or legacy project-local storage. In shared global storage, both active and archived plans must include the same verified repository key: `global/token-io-decoupling/repos/<repository-id>/plans/PLAN-[short-english-summary]` and `global/token-io-decoupling/repos/<repository-id>/archive-plans/PLAN-[short-english-summary]`. Optionally include a verified Issue number; omit `.md` from logical Memory names. Never place a new global plan directly in shared `plans/` or `archive-plans/`, and never use a basename, branch, remote URL, or worktree path as the repository key.

For this storage mapping, the repository key is `git-v1-` followed by the hexadecimal SHA-256 of `b"token-io-decoupling:git-common-dir:v1\0" + os.fsencode(str(canonical_git_common_dir))`, where `\0` denotes one NUL byte. Resolve the actual checkout root and canonical absolute Git common directory using trusted local repository facts. The main checkout and its linked worktrees share that common directory and key; independent repositories and independent clones have separate keys, even with identical names or remotes. Moving the common directory changes the key: stop to reconcile the old mapping rather than silently abandoning or migrating its plans. Missing or ambiguous repository identity blocks the global path. This is a local repository identity, not a portable identifier across machines. Reusing an old common-directory path reuses its key; confirm ownership and reconcile existing history before accepting a newly created repository at that path.

With an explicitly retained project-local backend, use `plans/PLAN-[short-english-summary]` and `archive-plans/PLAN-[short-english-summary]`; the default physical root is `<project-root>/.serena/memories/`. That compatibility mode does not provide cross-worktree sharing. Follow the actual configured Memory root and mapping, including authorized data-directory overrides; do not create a second store or invent a global root. Once shared global storage is selected, unavailable identity, root, mapping, or permission blocks that path instead of silently falling back to project-local storage. For a user-designated name, establish its corresponding archive mapping within existing authorization. Existing plans and archives keep their original mapping unless a separate authorized migration establishes ownership, checks collisions, preserves every byte, and verifies the result; never automatically adopt unscoped data from another project or rewrite an existing archive.

Confirm the exact project/worktree binding, storage scope, repository key when global, and effective memory-maintenance guidance. List only the selected repository's plan topics and read an existing matching plan before creating or updating it. A global listing may expose other repositories; visibility grants no authority to read or mutate them. Reuse only a plan for the same ongoing task; preserve unrelated plans and choose a distinct name on collision. Write the concise plan and read it back to compare with intent before dependent work. Missing required Memory capability, inaccessible required content, or failed write/readback blocks dependent work; report the exact operation and preserve the last confirmed plan.

### Plan content

Keep one concise shared plan with the goal and acceptance conditions; Issue or user-request source; constraints and non-goals; verified project facts and exact source pointers; chosen direction and unresolved questions; bounded steps, dependencies, and verification approach; completed/current/remaining work; actual checks, blockers, and residual risks. Distinguish facts, assumptions, proposals, and accepted decisions. Use compact deltas and useful current evidence rather than transcripts, full diffs, logs, or private reasoning. Concision applies to new entries; it never permits replacing accumulated content with a current-state or final summary. Preserve existing goals, constraints, requirement changes, sourced facts, decision reasons, stage progress, shared contributions, failures, and verification records. Mark a stale conclusion as superseded, retaining its original claim and evidence and adding the replacement, reason, and source; do not silently delete or rewrite its history.

### Preservation checks for every update

1. Immediately before writing, read the complete latest active plan, including every part if the response is paginated or truncated. Retain that readback as the comparison baseline in the authorized context. An incomplete read blocks the update; a remembered outline or earlier snapshot is insufficient.
2. Merge only the authorized local status/step changes and append new facts, results, or evidence to that baseline. Prefer a targeted edit. If only whole-document replacement is available, submit the full merged document, not a newly drafted summary. Preserve all other entries and contributions; apply the supersession rule above to changed conclusions.
3. Read back the complete updated plan and compare it with the baseline: each pre-existing record must remain traceable, with its provenance, reason, and evidence intact; only the authorized status/step changes and explicit supersessions may differ. Confirm new entries separately. A successful write or a spot check of final status alone does not pass preservation.
4. Missing content, conflicting contributions, or uncertain write/readback results block affected reporting, dependent actions, and archiving. Preserve the last confirmed baseline, reread current state, and reconcile under existing authorization before rechecking. Never blindly replay a stale replacement. Keep this comparison within authorized context; do not persist transcripts or private reasoning.

### Update before reporting or dependent action

Every participating Agent, including the parent and any verifier, reads the same current plan on entry/resume and before relying on its contents. After obtaining a new material project fact or changing task progress, persist the concise fact/status, provenance, and next step, then read back the affected entry before a progress report, handoff, or next action that depends on it. Routine unchanged tool output need not produce duplicate entries. Reports may cite the plan but cannot replace updating it.

For a changed user requirement, first record the new instruction and its source as pending analysis. Then analyze its impact on scope, dependencies, acceptance, and the proposed solution; persist and read back that analysis and revised plan. Only afterward may the parent authorize affected changes or dispatch. If the change arrives in a child context, record it within the child's permitted contribution and return it to the parent; the child cannot amend the Contract or release work. Keep unaffected authorized work available only when it does not depend on the pending change.

### Shared access and update coordination

The parent supplies the exact project root, Memory name, relevant source scope, and allowed contributions in every affected dispatch. Verify that each Agent can use the required Memory read/update operations in that project; sharing a name does not establish cross-Session access. If required access is unavailable, stop the dependent assignment and report it instead of silently replacing the Agent's write with an unverified relay or filesystem file.

Serialize updates to the shared plan. The parent coordinates one writer at a time; each writer rereads the latest entry immediately before changing only its permitted facts/status, preserves other contributions, and reads back its change before releasing the write turn. Do not assume atomic compare-and-swap or locks from a Memory tool. On conflict or uncertain write outcome, pause affected reporting/actions, reread and reconcile under the parent's existing authorization; never blindly overwrite or retry a stale full document.

The plan is shared task context, not the live parent mode/count/allocation/epoch record, an execution memo, or a source of authorization. Do not store that live scheduling state in it. Plan read/write access grants no access to other Memories, source files, raw peer context, or new effects. Respect the Context Firewall and each role's released scope; return proposals through the parent. A verifier may update only its named plan contribution and remains read-only for implementation and Git. A false execution-memo flag does not waive shared task-plan updates.

### Completion and archive

Keep the plan active while the task is incomplete or blocked. After every applicable Acceptance criterion passes:

1. Apply the preservation checks above to the complete active plan: update only completion status/steps and append final results, Acceptance evidence, and remaining limitations. Retain the accumulated document; a final summary may be appended but must never replace it. Read back and pass the full preservation comparison before archiving.
2. Retain this verified final active content as the archive baseline and confirm the matching archive target is absent. Archive only this completed task's plan by moving its namespace/name, without changing its content. A collision blocks the move; preserve both entries and report it.
3. Read back the complete archive and compare it with the final active baseline: content must be identical. List Memories to confirm the archive exists and the active name is absent. A missing record, content difference, or update/archive/readback failure blocks completion; preserve the last confirmed state and resolve uncertain effects before proceeding.

Archived plans are instruction-level immutable: never edit, delete, rename, or replace an existing archive, including to repair a failed archive comparison; tool visibility does not technically enforce this rule. Report such a mismatch for a separate authorized recovery decision. Never archive an unrelated or incomplete plan.

### Preservation acceptance scenario

Use a new synthetic plan in an authorized test scope, never an existing user's plan. Include multiple stages, a goal and constraint, a sourced requirement change, a decision with its reason, another contributor's entry, a failed check and later passing check. Include small facts such as “two untracked-file manifests verified” and “no PR template found” so a short final summary cannot accidentally pass. Supersede one conclusion with a reason and source, complete through the checks above, then archive. Verify every original record remains traceable, the superseded claim and its replacement both remain, final results were appended, the archive equals the final active baseline, and the active name disappeared. Also review a summary-only candidate and an occupied archive target: neither may advance to a write/move that loses content or overwrites an archive. Report actual exercised checks separately from scenario review; this does not prove tool-enforced immutability or recover past losses.

### 默认任务计划

所有现有及未来 Coding 路线都必须在实施前及执行全过程消费本 owner，无需用户额外要求计划或进入专用规划模式。遵守用户明确禁止持久化或更高优先级的写入限制：记录该例外，在获授权上下文内保持有界规划；工具缺失、权限不明或写入失败不得静默当作例外。若用户要求持久化计划而限制阻止持久化，则停止依赖工作并报告冲突。

有 Issue 时，先读取 Issue 和相关讨论，结合当前项目事实分析要求，在实施前综合改动方案。无 Issue 时，对用户明确提出的问题和当前项目事实采用相同流程。初始分析完成前，可用简明的临时计划记录目标、已知事实和待解问题，但不得声称已释放实现方向。实施或依赖派发前，必须持久化并读回具体计划。分析期间发现的新事实也必须先记录，再汇报或用于下一项依赖动作。

### 名称、存储和初始证据

优先复用用户为同一任务指定的 active plan。选择新名称前，确认获准后端使用共享全局存储还是旧版项目本地存储。共享全局存储中，活动与归档规划都必须带同一个已核验仓库 key：`global/token-io-decoupling/repos/<repository-id>/plans/PLAN-[short-english-summary]` 与 `global/token-io-decoupling/repos/<repository-id>/archive-plans/PLAN-[short-english-summary]`。可包含已核实的 Issue 编号；逻辑 Memory 名不含 `.md`。新全局规划不得直接放进共享的 `plans/` 或 `archive-plans/`，也不得用目录 basename、分支、remote URL 或 worktree 路径充当仓库 key。

本存储映射的仓库 key 为 `git-v1-` 加上 `b"token-io-decoupling:git-common-dir:v1\0" + os.fsencode(str(canonical_git_common_dir))` 的十六进制 SHA-256，其中 `\0` 表示一个 NUL 字节。通过可信本地仓库事实解析实际 checkout 根目录和 canonical absolute Git common directory。主工作区和 linked worktrees 共享该目录及 key；独立仓库和独立 clone 使用不同 key，即使名称或 remote 相同。共同目录搬迁会改变 key：应停止并核对旧映射，不得静默丢弃或迁移其规划。缺少或无法确定仓库身份时，阻塞全局路径。这是本机仓库身份，不是跨机器可移植标识。复用旧共同目录路径会复用其 key；在该路径接受新建仓库前，须确认归属并核对已有历史。

明确保留项目本地后端时，使用 `plans/PLAN-[short-english-summary]` 和 `archive-plans/PLAN-[short-english-summary]`；默认物理根为 `<project-root>/.serena/memories/`。该兼容模式不提供跨 worktree 共享。遵从实际配置的 Memory 根和映射，包括获准的数据目录覆盖；不得另建存储或虚构全局根。选定共享全局存储后，身份、根目录、映射或权限不可用时阻塞该路径，不得静默回退项目本地存储。用户自定名称的对应归档映射须在既有授权内明确。已有规划/归档保留原映射，除非另行获准的迁移确认归属、检查碰撞、保留全部字节并核验结果；不得自动收编其他项目未分层的数据或改写已有归档。

确认准确项目/worktree 绑定、存储 scope、全局模式的仓库 key 和有效的记忆维护说明。创建或更新前，仅列出所选仓库的规划 topic，并读取已存在的匹配计划。全局列表可能暴露其他仓库；可见不构成读取或修改它们的授权。仅复用同一进行中任务的计划；保留无关计划，碰撞时选择不同名称。写入精简计划，再读回比对意图，之后才继续依赖工作。必需 Memory 能力缺失、必需内容不可访问或写入/读回失败时，阻塞依赖工作；报告准确操作并保留最后确认的计划。

### 计划内容

维护一份精简共享计划，包含目标和验收条件、Issue 或用户请求来源、约束和非目标、已核实项目事实与准确来源指针、所选方向和未解问题、有界步骤/依赖/验证方法、已完成/当前/剩余工作，以及实际检查/阻塞/剩余风险。区分事实、假设、提议和已接受决定。使用精简增量和有用的当前证据，不存 transcript、完整 diff、日志或私有推理。精简适用于新增条目，绝不允许用当前状态或最终摘要替换累积内容。保留已有目标、约束、需求变化、带来源的事实、决策理由、阶段进展、共享贡献、失败和验证记录。过时结论须标记为已替代，保留原结论及证据，并补充替代结论、原因和来源；不得静默删除或改写其历史。

### 每次更新的内容保留检查

1. 写入前立即读取最新活动计划全文；响应分页或截断时须读全每一部分。在获授权上下文中保留该读回内容作为比对基线。读取不完整时阻塞更新；记忆中的提纲或旧快照不足以作为基线。
2. 仅向该基线合并获准的局部状态/步骤变更，并追加新事实、结果或证据。优先局部编辑。若仅支持全文替换，须提交合并后的完整文档，不能重新起草摘要。保留所有其他条目和贡献；结论变化遵守上述替代规则。
3. 读回更新后全文并与基线比较：每条已有记录都必须仍可追溯，来源、理由及证据保持完整；只允许获准状态/步骤更新和显式替代发生差异。另行确认新增条目。写入成功或仅抽查最终状态均不能通过内容保留检查。
4. 内容遗漏、贡献冲突或写入/读回结果不明时，阻塞受影响汇报、依赖动作和归档。保留最后确认基线，重读当前状态，在既有授权内协调后重新检查。不得盲目重放过时的全文替换。比对仅保留于获授权上下文，不持久化 transcript 或私有推理。

### 先更新，再汇报或执行依赖动作

所有参与 Agent，包括父级和验证者，在进入/恢复任务以及依赖内容前读取同一份当前计划。取得新的实质性项目事实或任务进度变化后，先持久化精简事实/状态、来源与下一步，再读回受影响条目，之后才汇报进度、交接或执行依赖该更新的动作。例行且未变化的工具输出无需重复记录。汇报可引用计划，但不能替代更新。

用户需求变化时，先把新指令及来源记录为待分析。再分析其对范围、依赖、验收和方案的影响，持久化并读回分析及修订计划。之后父级才可授权受影响改动或派发。子上下文收到变化时，只在获准贡献范围内记录并返回父级；子 Agent 不能修订 Contract 或释放工作。只有不依赖待处理变化时，才可继续不受影响的已授权工作。

### 共享访问与更新协调

父级在每次受影响派发中提供准确项目根目录、Memory 名称、相关来源范围和允许贡献。核实每个 Agent 能在该项目使用必需 Memory 读取/更新操作；共享名称不证明跨 Session 可访问。必需访问不可用时，停止依赖分配并报告，不得静默用未经核验的代写或文件替代该 Agent 的写入。

共享计划更新须串行。父级协调同一时刻一个写者；每个写者在变更前立即重读最新条目，只修改自己获准的事实/状态，保留其他贡献，并在释放写入轮次前读回变更。不得假定 Memory 工具提供原子比较交换或锁。发生冲突或写入结果不明时，暂停受影响汇报/动作，重读并在父级既有授权内协调，不得盲目覆盖或重试过时全文。

计划是共享任务上下文，不是父级实时 mode/count/allocation/epoch 记录、执行 memo 或授权来源；不得存储这些实时调度状态。计划读写不授予其他 Memory、源文件、原始同级上下文或新效果的访问权。遵守 Context Firewall 和各角色已释放范围；提议通过父级返回。验证者只可更新具名计划贡献，对实现和 Git 仍保持只读。执行 memo 标志为 false 不豁免共享任务计划更新。

### 完成与归档

任务未完成或阻塞时保持计划活动。所有适用 Acceptance 条件通过后：

1. 对活动计划全文应用上述内容保留检查：仅更新完成状态/步骤，并追加最终结果、Acceptance 证据和剩余限制。保留累积文档；可追加最终摘要，但绝不能用其替换全文。归档前读回并通过完整内容保留比对。
2. 保留已验证的最终活动内容作为归档基线，并确认匹配归档目标不存在。仅通过移动命名空间/名称归档本次已完成任务的计划，内容不得变化。碰撞时阻塞移动，保留两个条目并报告。
3. 读回归档全文并与最终活动基线比较：内容必须完全相同。列出 Memory，确认归档存在且活动名称已不存在。记录缺失、内容差异或更新/归档/读回失败均阻塞完成；保留最后确认状态，解决结果不明的效果后才能继续。

已有归档在指令层面不可变：不得编辑、删除、重命名或替换，包括为修复失败的归档比对而修改；工具可见不会技术性强制该规则。此类不一致须报告，交由另行获准的恢复决定处理。不得归档无关或未完成计划。

### 内容保留验收场景

在获准测试范围内使用新建的合成计划，绝不使用用户既有计划。包含多个阶段、目标和约束、带来源的需求变化、有理由的决策、其他贡献者条目、失败检查及后续通过检查。包含“两份未跟踪文件清单已核验”“未发现 PR 模板”等小事实，防止简短最终摘要意外通过。对一项结论注明替代原因和来源，经过上述检查完成计划，再归档。验证每条原记录仍可追溯，旧结论和替代结论并存，最终结果为追加内容，归档等于最终活动基线，且活动名称已消失。另外审查仅含摘要的候选和已占用的归档目标：两者均不得推进至会丢失内容的写入或覆盖归档的移动。分别报告实际演练检查和场景审查；这不证明工具强制不可变，也不恢复过去丢失的内容。

### Configured deterministic lifecycle tools

When the workflow MCP profile exposes an authorized, configured Serena backend, use `task_plan_update`, `task_plan_complete`, and `task_plan_archive` for plan mutations. Discovery alone is insufficient: confirm backend availability, the exact configured checkout, and the returned storage scope/repository mapping. For shared global storage, the operator explicitly constructs `SerenaMemoryStore(memory_manager, project_root, storage_scope="global")` from the actual Serena `MemoryManager`; the compatibility default remains `storage_scope="project"`. Explicit server injection or a trusted startup factory supplies that service. The global root must already exist; the service neither initializes it nor guesses its location. Do not invent a factory, load arbitrary code from a tool argument, install a dependency, or guess a `.serena` directory to make a call pass. The service does not automatically load or migrate Serena configuration.

Each request still supplies the exact service-bound checkout's absolute `project_root`; it cannot choose another repository or switch storage scope. Separately configured services for the main checkout and linked worktrees derive the same global repository identity, history, revision and replay scope. Inspect the returned scoped `memory_name` rather than rebuilding a bare name. Global history uses an explicit repository identity; legacy project history remains checkout-bound. The service checks repository identity again before global Memory effects and fails if it changed. Capability/receipt evidence does not authenticate the caller or grant access to other repositories. Git's common-directory semantics are documented in [git-rev-parse](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-rev-parse) and [repository layout](https://git-scm.com/docs/gitrepository-layout).

| Operation | Agent input and required result |
| --- | --- |
| `task_plan_update` | Submit only typed records with stable IDs, text and sources, the expected content revision, and an operation ID. Creation must explicitly expect absence. Adopt existing Markdown by retaining its opaque original content and appending typed records; declare goals and acceptance criteria rather than inferring them. A replacement references an existing record and supplies its reason; the old record remains. Never send a replacement document, free-form patch or regex. |
| `task_plan_complete` | Supply final results, limitations, the expected revision and operation ID, and evidence mapping every current declared criterion to passed verification records. Resolve blockers through appended records first. The service validates structure and preservation; it cannot prove the truth or semantic sufficiency of supplied evidence. |
| `task_plan_archive` | Supply the completed active plan identity and expected revision. The destination is the corresponding fixed archive namespace. Require an identical-content receipt and active-name absence; do not request reference propagation or arbitrary destination changes. |

Use each currently exposed payload schema for exact fields and bounds. The service performs the full baseline read, structured merge, preservation checks and readback internally; inspect its compact receipt for the matching project/plan, revision, state, replay and preservation result before relying on success. A revision conflict requires reading and reviewing current state before a new request. Identical update/completion retries reuse the original operation ID and payload; a changed payload needs a new ID. Reconciliation-required or uncertain effects block dependent work; do not bypass a selected service's failure by invoking raw Memory writes. These deterministic operations make no model or network requests.

The adapter honors Serena memory access policies and operates on its actual canonical files. Its lock serializes cooperating lifecycle-tool calls; direct Serena tools and external writers do not automatically join that lock. Do not claim global compare-and-swap, raw-tool ACLs, or immutable archives against outside writes. Stronger enforcement requires the host to restrict those other write channels. Missing host enforcement does not establish an unavailable capability or prevent unrelated authorized work; report the precise protection boundary.

### Native Memory path

If no configured lifecycle service has been selected, use only the Serena operations actually exposed and authorized, with all general preservation and storage-scope checks above: `list_memories`, `read_memory`, `write_memory` or `edit_memory`, and a permitted archive operation. Confirm project activation, the actual global-root mapping when selected, the verified repository key, and exact schemas. Filter listing to `global/token-io-decoupling/repos/<repository-id>/plans` or its corresponding archive topic. Supply logical names, never an absolute filesystem path as `memory_name`. If the current tools cannot establish the required identity or mapping, block the shared path; do not replace it with a worktree-local copy. Native `rename_memory` propagates `mem:` references, so establish that its effects remain authorized and the final content comparison can pass; otherwise stop that archive step. Never treat it as an atomic no-clobber primitive. Native `/plan`, local recall and chat compaction do not persist this shared record. One Session's successful calls do not prove another Agent's access; check each assigned Agent. [Codex MCP](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/extend/mcp).

### 已配置的确定性生命周期工具

workflow MCP profile 暴露已授权且已配置的 Serena 后端时，使用 `task_plan_update`、`task_plan_complete`、`task_plan_archive` 修改计划。仅发现工具不足以继续：须确认后端可用、准确配置 checkout，以及返回的存储 scope/仓库映射。共享全局模式由操作者以实际 Serena `MemoryManager` 显式构建 `SerenaMemoryStore(memory_manager, project_root, storage_scope="global")`；兼容默认值仍为 `storage_scope="project"`。通过显式服务注入或受信任启动 factory 提供该服务。实际全局根须已存在；服务不会初始化或猜测其位置。不得为了让调用通过而虚构 factory、从工具参数加载任意代码、安装依赖或猜测 `.serena` 目录。服务不会自动加载或迁移 Serena 配置。

每个请求仍提供该服务绑定 checkout 的准确绝对 `project_root`，不能选择其他仓库或切换存储 scope。主工作区及 linked worktrees 分别配置的服务派生同一全局仓库身份、history、revision 和 replay scope。检查返回的带项目层级 `memory_name`，不要重建裸名称。全局 history 使用明确仓库身份；旧项目 history 仍绑定 checkout。服务在全局 Memory 效果前重新核对仓库身份，发生改变则失败。capability/receipt 证据不认证调用者，也不授予其他仓库访问权。Git 共同目录语义见 [git-rev-parse](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-rev-parse) 和[仓库布局](https://git-scm.com/docs/gitrepository-layout)。

| 操作 | Agent 输入与必需结果 |
| --- | --- |
| `task_plan_update` | 仅提交具有稳定 ID、文本和来源的类型化记录，以及预期内容版本和操作 ID。创建须明确预期名称不存在。接管已有 Markdown 时，保留其不透明原文并追加类型化记录；显式声明目标和验收标准，不自动推断。替代须引用已有记录并给出原因，旧记录仍保留。绝不提交替换全文、自由格式 patch 或 regex。 |
| `task_plan_complete` | 提供最终结果、限制、预期版本和操作 ID，并将每项当前已声明标准映射到通过的验证记录。先通过追加记录解决 blocker。服务验证结构与内容保留，不能证明输入证据的真实性或语义充分性。 |
| `task_plan_archive` | 提供已完成活动计划身份和预期版本。目标固定为对应归档命名空间。要求内容完全一致的回执及活动名称消失；不得请求引用传播或任意改变目标。 |

准确字段和边界使用当前暴露的 payload schema。服务内部完成全文基线读取、结构化合并、内容保留检查与读回；依赖成功前，检查精简回执中的匹配项目/计划、版本、状态、重放及内容保留结果。版本冲突后，先读取并审阅当前状态，再提出新请求。完全相同的更新/完成重试复用原操作 ID 与 payload；payload 变化须使用新 ID。需要协调或效果不明时阻塞依赖工作；不得用原始 Memory 写入绕过已选服务的失败。这些确定性操作不发起模型或网络请求。

适配器遵守 Serena Memory 访问策略，并操作其实际规范文件。其锁只串行协调参与生命周期工具的调用；原始 Serena 工具和外部写者不会自动参与该锁。不得声称具有针对外部写入的全局比较交换、原始工具 ACL 或归档不可变保证。更强强制边界须由宿主限制其他写入通道。宿主未提供该强制边界不证明其他能力不可用，也不阻止无关获准工作；须准确报告保护范围。

### 原生 Memory 路径

未选择已配置的生命周期服务时，仅使用实际暴露且获准的 Serena 操作，并完成上述全部通用内容保留与存储 scope 检查：`list_memories`、`read_memory`、`write_memory` 或 `edit_memory`，以及获准的归档操作。确认项目激活、选定全局模式的实际根映射、已核验仓库 key 和准确 schema。列表限定为 `global/token-io-decoupling/repos/<repository-id>/plans` 或其对应归档 topic。提供逻辑名称，不得以绝对文件系统路径作为 `memory_name`。当前工具无法确认必需身份或映射时，阻塞共享路径，不得新建 worktree 本地副本替代。原生 `rename_memory` 会传播 `mem:` 引用，因此须先确认效果仍在授权范围内且最终内容比对能够通过，否则停止该归档步骤。绝不把它当成原子禁止覆盖原语。原生 `/plan`、本地回忆和聊天压缩不能持久化此共享记录。一个 Session 的成功调用不证明另一 Agent 的访问权；每个分配 Agent 均须检查。[Codex MCP](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/extend/mcp)。

When the capability is exposed and authorized, `decide_decoupling_workflow` accepts a bounded request under `payload.request`. The schema requires `mode_locked: true` and the canonical `mode_count`, along with all other required fields and bounded caller-supplied evidence; `stage` is `auto` or an explicit supported stage. `source_facts_hash` must match the supplied facts. Populate the complete current schema, including task identifiers and summary, language, capability and constraint records, source-fact references, and outbound-data assertion where applicable; this summary is not an exhaustive payload field list. Explicit stages are resolved locally after bounded rule checks. `auto` may make one Decisions request only when source facts are present, outbound data is permitted, and the configured capability allows it. The tool reloads relevant context and rechecks hashes before returning compact advice.

Only an `available` result is a suggestion; `insufficient_evidence`, `blocked`, and `stale` require direct review or refreshed facts/rules. Returned hashes do not cover the full Layer-04 route or prove it is unchanged; directly read the current selected route before acting. The result does not repeat full rules. The call is stateless and does not perform workflow actions. API failures are bounded and do not expose credentials or raw provider errors. Runtime/model and effort bindings remain in [Runtime and Model Provider Support](../session-runtime/runtime-provider-support.md).

当当前会话实际暴露并授权该能力时，`decide_decoupling_workflow` 接收 `payload.request` 下的有界请求。Schema 要求 `mode_locked: true` 和规范的 `mode_count`，以及其他全部必填字段和有界调用方证据；`stage` 为 `auto` 或受支持的显式阶段。`source_facts_hash` 必须与所提供事实匹配。应填写完整的当前 Schema，包括任务标识和摘要、语言、能力及约束记录、来源事实引用，以及适用时的出站数据声明；本节摘要不是完整 payload 字段清单。完成相关有界规则检查后，显式阶段在本地解析。只有存在来源事实、允许出站数据且配置能力允许时，`auto` 才可发出一次 Decisions 请求。工具会重新加载相关上下文并复核哈希，再返回简要建议。

只有 `available` 是建议；`insufficient_evidence`、`blocked` 和 `stale` 需要直接审查，或刷新事实和规则。返回哈希不覆盖完整 Layer-04 路线，也不能证明路线未变；行动前须直接读取当前选定路线。结果不会重复输出完整规则。调用无状态，不执行工作流动作。API 错误经过限界处理，不暴露凭据或原始服务错误。运行时、模型和推理力度绑定见 [Runtime and Model Provider Support](../session-runtime/runtime-provider-support_zh_cn.md)。

source_units.excerpt:
1. Name the failing evidence, affected paths, and smallest repair that can address it.
2. Identify the smallest candidate that could address the failure without assuming authorization.
3. If the candidate appears to change scope, architecture, security, compatibility, or another material decision, report that evidence and pause dependent repair pending the required decision.

1. 说明失败证据、受影响路径和能够解决问题的最小修复。
2. 识别可能解决失败的最小候选，不预设其已获授权。
3. 如果候选看起来会改变范围、架构、安全、兼容性或其他实质性决策，则报告该证据，并暂停依赖修复，等待所需决策。
This checkpoint does not authorize or execute repairs, run repair checks, define verification epochs, authorize broad cleanup, documentation, Git effects, or external effects.
本检查点不授权或执行修复，不运行修复检查，不定义验证 epoch，也不授权大范围清理、文档、Git 影响或外部影响。
The failing evidence, affected paths, and a smallest repair candidate are explicit, or the diagnostic result identifies the missing decision or capability.
失败证据、受影响路径和最小修复候选已经明确，或诊断结果已经指出缺少的决策或能力。

对于非简单工作，每次只放行一个 **Interaction Slice**。每个 slice 必须写明：

- `Objective`：必须产出的结果；
- `Authorized scope/mutations`：允许的路径、行为和写入；
- `Return conditions`：结束 slice 的证据或里程碑；
- `Unreleased boundary`：仍被阻塞的下一个子系统、风险域、语义选择或变更。

Slice 是控制单元，不是逐命令脚本。只要 Contract 和边界未变，执行者可以继续处理低决策密度的机械步骤；到达 return conditions 或跨越未放行边界前必须暂停。简单的快路径任务可以将实现和聚焦检查保留在一个 slice 中。

Use Coding for repository or project exploration, implementation, refactoring, debugging, tests, documentation, developer-tool output, and non-trivial Git work. The Coding workflow owns the common queue, module composition, runtime-environment selection, mode routing, checkpoints, verification boundaries, documentation/Git boundaries, and acceptance.

The optional enhanced subsystem is specified in the [Enhanced Workflow Architecture Contract](ENHANCED_ARCHITECTURE.md); the existing Native workflow remains applicable.

仓库或项目探索、实现、重构、调试、测试、文档、开发工具输出以及非简单 Git 工作均使用 Coding。Coding 工作流负责共用队列、模块组合、运行环境选择、模式路由、checkpoint、验证边界、文档/Git 边界和验收。

可选增强子系统契约见[增强工作流架构契约](ENHANCED_ARCHITECTURE_zh_cn.md)；现有 Native 工作流仍然适用。

1. For material changes, use an independent Change Verification Session when the Contract requires it.
2. Label same-Session checks as logical verification; do not call them independent verification.

1. 对实质性修改，在 Contract 要求时使用独立的 Change Verification Session。
2. 将同一 Session 中的检查标记为逻辑验证，不称为独立验证。

Independence status is explicitly classified: the required independent Session has verified the change, or same-Session checks are labeled logical and independence unavailable. The latter is a recorded limitation, **not** satisfaction of a Contract that requires independent verification; dependent effects remain blocked.
独立性状态已明确分类：必需的独立 Session 已完成验证，或同 Session 检查标记为逻辑验证且独立验证不可用。后一种只是记录限制，**不**代表满足 Contract 所要求的独立验证；依赖影响继续阻塞。

1. Record passed, failed, unavailable, and assumed checks, together with residual risks.
2. Explicitly report every unresolved verification item and its blocking effect.

1. 记录通过、失败、不可用和假设的检查，以及剩余风险。
2. 明确报告每个未解决的验证项目及其阻塞影响。
The required result categories, residual risks, unresolved items, and blocking effects are explicit.
必需的结果分类、剩余风险、未解决项目和阻塞影响都已明确。

1. Capture the current final-state fingerprint or epoch and the acceptance conditions.
2. Run the strongest applicable holistic and targeted checks against that exact state.

1. 记录当前最终状态的指纹或 epoch，以及验收条件。
2. 针对这个准确状态运行适用的最强整体检查和定向检查。

This checkpoint does not define independent verification Sessions, classify or report results, invalidate later epochs, repair failures, write documentation, perform Git effects, or declare overall acceptance by itself.
本检查点不定义独立验证 Session，不分类或报告结果，不使后续 epoch 失效，不修复失败，不写文档，不产生 Git 影响，也不能单独宣布整体验收完成。
Every required verification item has current evidence, or the evidence gap is explicit and prevents completion.
每个必需验证项目都有当前证据，或证据缺口已明确并阻止完成。

1. Track three dimensions: implementation/content, documentation, and Git metadata.
2. Advance the implementation/content epoch when implementation, configuration, tests, or other content covered by product verification changes; invalidate earlier product verification for that changed content.
3. Advance the documentation epoch when maintained documentation or comments change. Run the applicable Markdown, link, whitespace, multilingual, and scope checks. If the change alters executable content, the Contract, or acceptance conditions, also treat it as an implementation/content change and return to implementation Verification.
4. Advance the Git metadata epoch when commit, branch, index, or history state changes. Do not advance the implementation/content or documentation epoch for Git metadata operations alone. Git state still requires the Git checkpoint to confirm that staged or committed content matches the latest verified fingerprints; content divergence or unverified content returns to the corresponding Verification epoch.
5. Do not use evidence from an earlier epoch for an affected dimension; require the applicable checks or Verification for the new epoch.

6. If the route supplies verification-impact advisory output, treat it only as a coverage-dimension suggestion. Confirm candidate dimensions against current fingerprints and the direct owner; it is not a verification verdict and cannot waive checks or re-verification for changed dimensions. Determine required coverage from current evidence. Apply [Decisions Advisory](../../layer-01-fundamental-concepts/execution-planning/decisions-advisory.md) for advisory policy.

source_units.excerpt:
1. 跟踪三个维度：implementation/content、documentation 和 Git metadata。
2. 当实现、配置、测试或其他被产品验证覆盖的内容发生变化时，推进 implementation/content epoch；该内容的早期产品验证失效。
3. 当维护中的文档或注释发生变化时，推进 documentation epoch，并运行适用的 Markdown、链接、空白、多语言和范围检查。如果变化改动了可执行内容、Contract 或验收条件，还必须同时视为 implementation/content 变化，返回实现 Verification。
4. 当 commit、branch、index 或 history 状态发生变化时，推进 Git metadata epoch。仅 Git metadata 操作不会推进 implementation/content 或 documentation epoch。但 Git 状态仍须经过 Git 检查点确认 staged 或 committed content 与最新验证指纹一致；内容发生差异或包含未验证内容时，返回对应的 Verification epoch。
5. 不得将受影响维度的早期 epoch 证据用于当前状态；必须完成新 epoch 所需的检查或 Verification。

6. 路线提供 verification-impact 建议输出时，仅将其视为覆盖维度建议。必须根据当前 fingerprint 和直接 owner 核验候选维度；它不是验证结论，不能免除变化维度所需的检查或重新验证。依据当前证据确定必需覆盖。建议政策遵循[Decisions 建议](../../layer-01-fundamental-concepts/execution-planning/decisions-advisory_zh_cn.md)。

source_units.excerpt: This checkpoint does not capture fingerprints, choose checks, define independent verification, classify results, authorize repairs, write documentation, or perform Git effects.
本检查点不捕获指纹，不选择检查，不定义独立验证，不分类结果，不授权修复，不写文档，也不产生 Git 影响。

The latest applicable implementation/content, documentation, and Git metadata epochs are explicit, their required checks or Verification are queued or complete, and no affected dimension relies on stale evidence.
最新的 implementation/content、documentation 和 Git metadata 适用 epoch 已明确，各自所需的检查或 Verification 已排队或完成，且没有任何受影响维度依赖过期证据。
